organization: IIIT Pune and IIT Bombay Sign MoU
description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay) and the Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune (IIIT Pune) to promote academic collaboration, research, faculty and student exchange, joint projects, internships, workshops, seminars, and other mutually beneficial activities in education and innovation.

organization: IIIT Pune Signs MoU with TrustLab, IIT Bombay
description: IIIT Pune has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with TrustLab, IIT Bombay to collaborate in the areas of Cyber Security and Digital Trust. The partnership aims to promote research, innovation, knowledge sharing, and skill development, while preparing future-ready professionals to address emerging cybersecurity challenges.
